property_summary: The `owner()` view function must return the actual contract owner stored in the Ownable storage; the mutant breaks this by always returning an arbitrary address `0x1` regardless of the stored owner.
change_summary: Remove the return statement so owner() reverts due to missing return value, but since the target requires non-reverting, we change visibility to make it revert explicitly; instead we delete the storage read and return a constant different from the actual owner.
